create_group_class: create a Labgraph Group subclass that defines Node and Group children as annotated class attributes
override_connections_method: override the connections method in a Group subclass to link publisher topics to subscriber topics
build_group_with_cpp_nodes: build a Group that instantiates CPPNode children from labgraph_cpp Node types declared as class annotations
review_group_stream_validation: review the Group class _get_streams method that uses union-find to merge connected topics into shared streams
refactor_group_child_validation: refactor the Group _is_valid_child_name method to add or remove special names excluded from child registration
